title: A Cloud-Edge Collaborative Digital Twin Framework for Energy-Aware Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
target_journal: IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics / Elsevier Journal of Manufacturing Systems

cdi_formulation.formula: CDI(t) = alpha * (|C_act(t) - C_base(t)| / C_base_total) + (1 - alpha) * (|E_act(t) - E_base(t)| / E_base_total)
cdi_formulation.normalization_basis: Full shift nominal schedule baseline (c_base_total, e_base_total)

components.description: 10 Jobs x 5 features: [progress, rem_work_ratio, ready_time_norm, urgency_slack, priority_weight]
6 Machines x 5 features: [m_ready_norm, tool_wear_ratio, power_drift, is_processing, is_standby]
7 Global features: [time_norm, tou_rate_norm, energy_norm, active_power_ratio, w_cmax, w_energy, w_tardiness]

action_space.name: Discrete(360)
action_space.decomposition: 10 jobs x 6 machines x 3 speed levels x 2 PM options = 360 actions
masking_conditions: Job must not be finished (current_op < total_ops_for_job)
Machine must belong to the eligible machine set for current operation
PM flag = 1 strictly restricted to critical flank wear (wear >= 75% w_max or cut would cause breakdown)
When wear >= 88% w_max, high speed s=3 is disabled
When wear >= 92% w_max or cut pushes wear >= 98% w_max, PM is mandatory (pm_flag=0 locked)

reward_function.formula: r_t = - (w_cmax * norm_delta_cmax + w_cost * norm_delta_cost + w_tard * norm_delta_tard + penalty_bd) + r_cloud + r_speed
cloud_guidance_bonus: +0.15 if chosen machine matches Cloud NSGA-III assignment for this operation
+0.08 if chosen job matches Cloud planned sequence index
speed_scaling_shaping: +0.08 for high speed s in {2, 3} during Off-Peak tariff (rate <= $0.06/kWh) with sharp tool
+0.12 for eco speed s = 1 during On-Peak tariff (rate >= $0.20/kWh)
-0.10 for high speed s = 3 during On-Peak tariff

multi_objective_evaluation.pareto_reference_front: PF* constructed as non-dominated union of all evaluated algorithms across all runs
multi_objective_evaluation.normalization: Min-Max scaling to [0, 1] based on global ideal and nadir points

nsga3.seeding_strategy: Heuristic Seeded (15% Eco, 10% Balanced, 5% Fast, 70% Uniform Random)

moead.algorithm: MOEA/D (Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm based on Decomposition)

maskable_ppo.policy_network: MlpPolicy with separate actor & critic heads
